_comment: 20-minute (1200 s) single-shot capture of a slow ECM waveform. horizontal_scale 120 s/div x 10 divisions = 1200 s across the screen. A low sample rate (10 S/s) is plenty for a 1 mHz signal and keeps the record small (10 S/s x 1200 s = 12000 pts). AUTO trigger so the acquisition starts immediately (little delay). NOTE: 120 s/div exceeds the Keysight DSO-X 3034G max (50 s/div) - use the Tektronix MSO24 for this capture. CH1: 1.5 V/div DC 1 MOhm.
name: ecm_20min
